info.title: API.SH: Indeed
info.description: The Indeed API from API.SH: public Indeed data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
A company's Indeed page: overall rating and review count, rating by category (work/life balance, pay and benefits, job security and advancement, management, culture) and by year, work happiness scores, CEO and CEO approval, description, founded, headquarters, employee range, revenue range, industry, website, open jobs by location and title, salaries by role, review locations, recent reviews, FAQ and similar companies.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/indeed-company

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Company name as in its Indeed link (indeed.com/cmp/<name>), e.g. `Google`, `Starbucks`, `Bank-of-America`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of `name`: the company's Indeed link (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/<name>).

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Indeed country site to read the company page from: us (default), gb, ca, au, nz, ie, de, at, ch, fr, be, nl, es, it, pt, pl, se, in, sg, my, ph, jp, ae, za, br, mx, ar. Links in the answer point at that site.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The open jobs on a company's Indeed page: title, location, salary text, job id and link, with the company's total open jobs and how many match the filters. 20 jobs per page; across the United States unless a location is given.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/indeed-company-jobs

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Company name as in indeed.com/cmp/<Company>. name or url is required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An indeed.com/cmp/<company> link, instead of name.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words the job must match.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City, state, zip code or remote. Default: the whole United States.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (20 jobs per page). Pass next_page from the previous response.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Indeed country site to read the company page from: us (default), gb, ca, au, nz, ie, de, at, ch, fr, be, nl, es, it, pt, pl, se, in, sg, my, ph, jp, ae, za, br, mx, ar. Links in the answer point at that site.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A company's employee reviews on Indeed, newest first, 20 per page: title, text, overall and category ratings, job title, location, current/former employee, date, helpful votes and employer replies, plus the page's pros and cons summary and review counts. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/indeed-company-reviews

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Company name as in its Indeed link (indeed.com/cmp/<name>).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of `name`: the company's Indeed link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Reviews from one country (two-letter code), or `ALL`. Indeed's default is the US.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Reviews from one location, e.g. `Seattle, WA`.

parameters.name: job_title
parameters.description: Reviews from one job title, e.g. `Barista`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Indeed country site to read the company page from: us (default), gb, ca, au, nz, ie, de, at, ch, fr, be, nl, es, it, pt, pl, se, in, sg, my, ph, jp, ae, za, br, mx, ar. Links in the answer point at that site.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Indeed salaries for a job title
get.description:
Pay for a job title across the United States or in one city or state: the typical salary (median, low, high, mean, number of reports) in its usual pay period and in every other period, national figures, other compensation, the average by state, the top paying cities and companies, related titles with their pay, the skills, certifications and fields of study that move pay, and current jobs with pay.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/indeed-salaries

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: A job title.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City and state (e.g. Austin, TX) or a state. Default: the whole United States.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Indeed shows signed-out visitors one page of results. `country` searches another country's Indeed site (job links then point at that site and the response carries `country`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/indeed-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Alias of `l`: city and state, zip, or "remote".

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Miles around the location.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Posted within the last 1, 3, 7 or 14 days.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default) or date.

parameters.name: salary
parameters.description: Minimum yearly salary, USD (country=us only).

parameters.name: job_type
parameters.description: full_time, part_time, contract, temporary, internship or permanent.

parameters.name: experience
parameters.description: entry, mid or senior.

parameters.name: remote
parameters.description: 1 for remote jobs, hybrid for hybrid.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Which Indeed site to search (default us): us, gb (or uk), ca, au, nz, ie, de, at, ch, fr, be, nl, es, it, pt, pl, se, in, sg, my, ph, jp, ae, za, br, mx, ar.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Only page 1 is available: Indeed asks visitors to sign in from page 2.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
